exposure: laparoscopic, transvaginal, and transabdominal cesarean scar resection
curettage after methotrexate (MTX) injection into the local gestational sac
curettage by pituitrin combined with ultrasonic monitoring and hysteroscopy-guided surgery
cohort: 314 cases of CSP treated in the department of Obstetrics and Gynecology of the First Affiliated Hospital of Gannan Medical University between June 2017 and June 2020
finding: Curettage by pituitrin combined with ultrasonic monitoring and hysteroscopy-guided surgery is an effective and relatively safe treatment for patients with type I and II CSP, while laparoscopic surgery is more suitable for type III CSP.
